processing.description_ru: Восстановление атласа Real-ESRGAN, затем SDXL img2img; в итог перенесены новые высокочастотные детали поверхности через overlay.

parameters.residual: P=(D+1)/2; Q=Blur(D)/2; H=P-Q=0.5+0.5*(D-Blur(D)); optional H self-overlay; overlay H on baseline

edge_policy.tiles: Filtered self-tiling context; bilinear interior transition; exact original NN alpha

palette.conversion: RGB6 channels << 2; invalid >63 triplets black; no runtime lighting or palette cycles

qa.limitation: Technical asset checks and static comparisons; artistic review and runtime rendering remain separate.

registration.units: HD pixels; derived by multiplying original integer registration by four

original.coordinate_units: original game pixels; retain for integration
original.scale_policy: Scale the original canvas, alpha and original integer placement/pivot together. Do not recompute pivot from enhanced dimensions.
original.draw_order: Preserve CE object ordering, elevation, flags, lighting and occlusion; PNG alone does not implement these.

registration.placement_rule: Scale original placement and pivot. Do not recompute center/bottom from HD dimensions.
